transcript.label: What we heard
transcript.empty: Your words will appear here as you speak.

notice.onDevice: Recognized on this device — works offline.
notice.network: This language may need an internet connection on this device. Install the offline speech pack in your device settings to use it offline.

permissionDenied.title: Microphone access needed
permissionDenied.message: Allow microphone and speech recognition to add expenses by voice. You can still enter them manually.

permissionBlocked.title: Microphone access is off
permissionBlocked.message: Turn on microphone and speech recognition for this app in your device settings, or enter the expense manually.

unavailable.title: Voice entry isn't available
unavailable.message: This device has no speech recognition service. Please enter the expense manually.

languageUnsupported.title: Language not supported
languageUnsupported.message: Speech recognition on this device doesn't support this language. Choose another voice language or enter the expense manually.

noSpeech.title: We didn't hear anything
noSpeech.message: Tap the microphone and speak clearly, close to the phone.

network.title: Connection problem
network.message: Recognition for this language needs the internet on this device. Check your connection, or enter the expense manually.

busy.title: Microphone is busy
busy.message: Another app is using speech recognition. Please try again in a moment.

interrupted.title: Recording stopped
interrupted.message: Recording was interrupted. Please try again.

unknown.title: Something went wrong
unknown.message: Speech recognition failed. Please try again or enter the expense manually.

missing.amount: We couldn't catch the amount. Please enter it.

uncertain.amount: We heard more than one amount — please enter the right one.
uncertain.category: This could fit more than one category — please choose.

empty.title: Nothing to review
empty.message: Record an expense by voice first.
